I need to see your code to nail down the cause — there are usually just a few culprits. Can you share the parent component and the child component?

The most common ones are:

1. **Parent re-renders** — even with the same props, if the parent rerenders, React rerenders all children by default
2. **New object each render** — passing `onClick={() => {...}}` or `style={{...}}` creates a new reference every render, so React sees "different" props
3. **Missing memoization** — wrapping the child in `React.memo()` stops rerenders when props truly haven't changed

Once you share your components, I can tell you exactly which one it is and show you the fix.
